Working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, Visio, SharePoint, and other project management or reporting platforms used to support project controls deliverables. Knowledge of nuclear project governance, quality assurance expectations, regulatory awareness, safety culture, and site access requirements is preferred. Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex planning teams and influence multidisciplinary stakeholders in a JV, client-facing, or matrixed project environment.
